---
title: "Welcome"
---

Mallards (*Anas platyrhynchos*) are familiar ducks found across the Northern Hemisphere. Between 2007 and 2017, researchers tracked 52 Mallards at Lake Constance, a large freshwater lake bordering Germany, Switzerland, and Austria. The study produced 83,279 GPS observations that reveal how individual ducks move throughout Central Europe.

The **Map** page shows where the ducks traveled. Most recorded locations cluster near Lake Constance, although some birds moved hundreds of kilometers north and east. The **Seasons** page explores how movement speed changes throughout the year, with most fixes showing slow movement and greater activity during the summer months.

The data comes from Korner, Sauter, Fiedler, and Jenni (2016) and is publicly available through [Movebank](https://movebank.org/).
